title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash API Public Beta Launches, Agent Capabilities Fully Emerge

content_html:
The tech industry is witnessing a new round of efficiency revolution. The Seed team under ByteDance has officially launched the Seedance2.5 audio-visual joint generation model, which focuses on the "one-shot filming" capability, and comprehensively empowers multiple industrial scenarios.

In terms of narrative expression, Seedance2.5 extends the single-generation duration from 15 seconds to 30 seconds and supports seamless extension over multiple rounds, making complex storylines more coherent. At the same time, the model has deeply refined materials, lighting, and skin texture, effectively reducing the plastic feel of traditional generated videos and presenting a more realistic, camera-like quality.

Regarding diverse creative needs, this version significantly enhances the multimodal reference function. Creators can input up to 30 images, 10 video clips, and 10 audio segments in a single session. The addition of white model references and lighting control mechanisms makes physical lighting and motion trajectories more realistic and stable.

Additionally, Seedance2.5 has made fine-tuned upgrades in post-editing and controllability. Users can make targeted adjustments to details such as the visual perspective, camera movement rhythm, and green screen background through timestamps, thereby reducing the cost of post-production editing. Currently, the model is gradually launching on platforms such as Ji Meng AI and Dou Bao Professional Edition, with API services also expected to be available on Huoshan Fangzhou soon.

content_html_zh:
科技行业正在见证新一轮的效率革命。 字节跳动旗下Seed团队正式推出Seedance2.5视听联合生成模型，主打“一拍即拍”能力，全面赋能多个行业场景。

在叙事表达方面，Seedance2.5将单代时长从15秒延长至30秒，并支持多轮无缝延伸，让复杂的故事情节更加连贯。 同时，模型对材质、光照、皮肤纹理进行了深度细化，有效降低了传统生成视频的塑料感，呈现出更加真实、相机般的品质。

针对多样化的创意需求，该版本显着增强了多模态参考功能。 创作者可以在单个会话中输入最多 30 个图像、10 个视频剪辑和 10 个音频片段。 白色模型参考和照明控制机制的添加使物理照明和运动轨迹更加真实和稳定。

此外，Seedance2.5在后期编辑和可控性方面也做了微调升级。 用户可以通过时间戳对视觉视角、镜头移动节奏、绿屏背景等细节进行针对性调整，从而降低后期剪辑成本。 目前，该模型已逐步在极萌AI、豆宝专业版等平台上线，API服务也有望很快在霍山方洲上线。
